attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Massachusetts corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Massachusetts Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.ma_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($500K gross receipts)
condition_details.condition_description: result.ma_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ma_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.ma_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.ma_tax_liability xdef "Massachusetts filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Massachusetts state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. MA requires addback of federal interest, IRC 199A deduction. MA allows deduction for dividends from 15%+ owned subsidiaries.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Massachusetts Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.ma_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.ma_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Massachusetts state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.ma_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.ma_state_subtractions xdef "Massachusetts adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Massachusetts corporate income tax. Applies Massachusetts flat rate (8.0%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Massachusetts Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.ma_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ma_tax_liability xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ma_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: // No taxable income - no tax liability 0.0 result.ma_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ma_tax_liability xdef result.ma_estimated_payments result.ma_refund_or_owed xdef "Massachusetts tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto

// No nexus - no tax liability 0.0 result.ma_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ma_tax_liability xdef result.ma_estimated_payments result.ma_refund_or_owed xdef "Massachusetts tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
